debt.step: Look at the StepChange website for ten minutes.
debt.note: StepChange is a free debt charity. You do not have to contact them yet, just see what they offer.

debt.step: Save the National Debtline number in your phone.
debt.note: 0808 808 4000, free and confidential. Having it ready makes it easier to call on a good day.
ClearScore, Experian or Equifax all have free versions. Just look; nothing to fix today.

debt.step: Write down one balance you have been avoiding looking at.
debt.note: Only one. Knowing the number usually feels better than not knowing.

debt.step: Check whether any direct debit is for something you no longer use.
debt.note: One quick scroll through your banking app is enough.

debt.step: Read StepChange's page on debt management plans.
debt.note: Just to understand what one is, with no commitment.
Find the one with the highest rate. That is usually the one to tackle first.

debt.step: Look up 'Breathing Space' on the Gov.uk website.
debt.note: A legal scheme that can pause interest and enforcement for 60 days while you get advice.

debt.step: Use a free benefits calculator such as Turn2us or entitledto.
debt.note: It only takes a few minutes, and many people are missing money they are entitled to.

debt.step: Set up one reminder for a payment date.
debt.note: Calendar or banking app. A small guard against late fees.

debt.step: If you are ready, book a call with StepChange or National Debtline.
debt.note: Free, no judgement. Only if today feels like the day.

debt.step: Notice one thing that went well with money this month.

job.step: Find one GRC role that looks interesting and save it.
job.note: No need to apply today. Just collect it.

job.step: Apply for one GRC role you have saved.
job.note: One application is a good day.
Say what you do and what you want, e.g. 'GRC professional | Risk, compliance and data protection'.

job.step: Add one recent achievement to your LinkedIn or CV.
job.note: Use a number if you can: an audit passed, a policy written, a risk reduced.

job.step: Turn on 'Open to work' for recruiters only on LinkedIn.
job.note: Only recruiters see it, not your current employer's network.

job.step: Follow three companies you would like to work for.
job.note: Their posts will start showing you what they value.

job.step: Ask one person for a LinkedIn recommendation.
job.note: A colleague or old manager. A short message is fine.

job.step: Look up the salary range for your next role.
job.note: Check a few job adverts or a salary guide so you know your worth.

job.step: Comment thoughtfully on one GRC post on LinkedIn.
job.note: Being visible helps recruiters find you.

job.step: Message one recruiter who specialises in GRC.
job.note: Keep it short: who you are, what you want, a link to your profile.

job.step: Tidy one section of your CV.
job.note: Just one: the summary, skills or a role.

job.step: Add a skill to your LinkedIn skills list.
job.note: Such as ISO 27001, risk assessment, third-party risk or GDPR.

side.note: Try it on a practice tip or your own nails. It does not need to be perfect.

side.step: Take a good photo of a nail set you have done.
side.note: Natural light by a window works best.

side.step: Save three nail designs you would like to try.
side.note: Pinterest or Instagram. Collecting ideas counts.

side.step: Practise a clean cuticle line or a neat French tip.
side.note: Basics make everything else look professional.

side.step: Make one simple interior design render.
side.note: One room, one idea. A mood or colour study is enough.

side.step: Save three rooms you love and note what they share.
side.note: Colour, light, materials? Learning your own taste is the work.

side.step: Learn one new tool or shortcut in your design software.
side.note: Ten minutes on a tutorial is plenty.

side.step: Restyle one corner of your home and photograph it.
side.note: A shelf or a bedside table. Real projects build a portfolio.

side.step: Look at what local nail techs charge.
side.note: Just research. It helps you price your own work when ready.

side.step: Post one piece of work, nails or interiors.
side.note: Only if it feels good. Sharing builds confidence.

side.step: Watch one short tutorial in either craft.
Write down one small side income goal for this month.
